canonical_project: CTS Group / NordicEPOD production campus (Viana do Castelo)
owner: CTS Group (Norway) with Eaton - NordicEPOD JV
notes: CTS Group (Nordic data centre design/build leader) with Eaton is building its largest production campus in Viana do Castelo: a EUR 50M factory producing EPOD power-distribution units for data centres, ~500 jobs, ~450 EPODs/year; construction started (Feb 2025 announcement; June 2026 construction report). This is datacenter supply-chain/manufacturing infrastructure, not an operating DC - recorded for division completeness.
